response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER') as order_ref, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER')), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as bench1 FROM order_averages), filtered_first AS (SELECT oa.order_ref, oa.avg_remain, oa.avg_remain - fb.bench1 as excess1 FROM order_averages oa, first_benchmark fb WHERE oa.avg_remain > fb.bench1), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as bench2 FROM filtered_first), filtered_second AS (SELECT ff.order_ref, ff.avg_remain, ff.excess1, ff.avg_remain - sb.bench2 as excess2 FROM filtered_first ff, second_benchmark sb WHERE ff.avg_remain > sb.bench2) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as final_avg, AVG(excess1) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(excess2) as avg_excess_over_second FROM filtered_second
